name: Chao Level Test
description: Nothing but chao_level, on a clean ROM, so any difference is this feature. A solo player cannot level a Chao past 1 - levels 2 and 3 each need a wireless trade with a different person - so every Chao here grants its level-3 effects from the moment it hatches. Check a Chao with a stat the item panel actually draws: Rugle is Luck +1 in vanilla and should read Luck +3, Churdle Attack +1 to +3, Koolet Defense +1 to +3.
